completed.hypothesis: Specific question-led titles and concise action summaries will earn more qualified search visits than broad cybersecurity explainers.
completed.change: Launch articles target one concrete reader decision and expose a three-line action summary above the fold.
completed.primaryMetric: Search clicks per indexed article after 28 days
completed.result: No result recorded. The scheduled decision date arrived without a verified traffic source, and known search clicks, impressions, and returning readers remain null. The available evidence cannot show whether the treatment increased qualified search visits.
completed.decision: Close the launch experiment without declaring a winner or changing publication positioning. Keep the existing question-led, action-summary format as the current editorial presentation rather than treating it as a measured growth result.
